tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search 1-800Deals, a national directory of toll-free and vanity-number businesses (water damage restoration, plumbing, pest control, HVAC, garage doors, electricians, roofing). Read-only. Filter by keyword, category and city. Returns public listing fields only: id, name, listing page url, descriptio

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Read-only. Full public details for one 1-800Deals listing by the id from search_listings (or its slug): full description, address, phone, website, hours, FAQ and photos. Returns NOT_FOUND for an unknown id.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Read-only. List the 1-800Deals directory's business categories with listing counts.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
